elements.description: A fine, slowly drifting line grid behind its children, fading out towards the edges.

properties.name: color
properties.description: Line colour – defaults to a faint black, or a faint white in dark mode

properties.name: speed
properties.description: Seconds per cell; 0 keeps the grid still

properties.name: playFor
properties.description: Seconds the grid drifts before it rests; Infinity never stops – then give users a way to pause it (WCAG 2.2.2)

properties.name: direction
properties.description: Drift direction; "diagonal" runs from top right to bottom left

properties.name: reveal
properties.description: Uncover the grid with a growing circle when it first comes into view (attribute: reveal="false" turns it off)

properties.name: fade
properties.description: Radius of the edge fade, in % of the distance to the corners

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered above the grid

props.name: size
props.description: Cell size in px

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: @property
features.without: The registered custom properties don't interpolate, so the transitions and spins they drive jump to their end state.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.
